issues.description: Fields: lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors. Problem statement (UML) declares these attributes as private (shown with '-' in the UML at lines 63-68). The template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) currently declares two attributes as public (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents at lines 4-5) and omits the remaining attributes, leaving TODOs. The solution (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java) declares all five attributes as private (lines 6-10). This inconsistency between the template (public fields) and the UML/solution (private fields) can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and whether they should access fields directly or implement getters/setters.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to declare all five attributes as private to match the UML and solution. Specifically replace the public field declarations with: private String lectureName; private int numberOfInscribedStudents; private int numberOfGuestStudents; private int numberOfLecturers; private int numberOfTutors; Keep the existing TODO comments for students to implement the constructor, getters and setters so the exercise intent (teaching encapsulation and accessor methods) is preserved.
